data.description: The page of results. Empty when nothing matches; never null.

total.description: Total records matching the filter, across all pages.

limit.description: The limit applied to this response, after clamping.

type.description: Nature of the money or asset movement.
type.title: TransactionType

amount.description: Movement amount in the major unit of `currency`. Always positive; direction follows `type`.

reference.description: Client-supplied or system-generated reference carried through to the counterparty.

notes.description: Free-text note. Null when none was supplied.

401.description: The Bearer token is missing, malformed, or expired.

status.description: HTTP status code, repeated in the body for clients that log bodies only.

request_id.description: Identifier for this call. Quote it in any support request.

details.description: Present on 422 only. One entry per rejected field.

example.message: Bearer token is missing or has expired.
